name: io.github.davidmosiah/ifood-mcp
description: Unofficial local-first iFood MCP: restaurants, cart, addresses and orders. Checkout is fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: IFOOD_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal iFood JWT. Prefer `ifood-mcp-unofficial auth start --email`.

environmentVariables.name: IFOOD_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow cart writes and checkout. Default false (never pays).
